title: Convert MB to KB
about: Convert megabytes to kilobytes with the standard binary file-size relationship. Enter a value in MB and BROBEX calculates its equivalent in KB immediately, with adjustable decimal precision and a copy control.
steps: Enter a non-negative value in megabytes.
Choose the number of decimal places if needed.
Copy the result or reset the converter.
capabilities: Instant local calculation using 1 MB = 1,024 KB. This utility converts a numerical file-size value only; it does not upload, resize or alter a file.
benefits: Quickly translate file-size values between MB and KB when checking upload requirements, image dimensions or document limits.
limitations: This tool converts values only and does not change a file. It uses the binary convention of 1 MB = 1,024 KB; some services display decimal units.

faqs.question: How many KB are in 1 MB?
faqs.answer: Using the binary convention, 1 MB equals 1,024 KB.

faqs.question: Does this tool compress an image?
faqs.answer: No. It converts a file-size number. Use Compress Image to Target KB to optimize an actual image file.
